a: nm:gene cap n warmack s drummer

items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Had a drummer in there by the name of Gene.

ctx.x: Forth there -- was a band, colored band by the name of Cap'n -- that's for captain -- but Cap'n Warmack. Had a drummer in there by the name of Gene. I can't recall his name. Nice personality. But the band was a society band. Cap'n Warmack's band.

He didn't do too much swinging. This is society. They held the job. They held forth at Willie's Lakeshore Garden when that surprising musician's strike, waiter's strike was simultaneously done there. I don't know what they were thinking about because it was the height of the Depression, '29, and they decided to strike.
